senses.gloss:
गुटिका गुटिका, f. a pill, a bolus, any small
globe or ball; a small pustule; the cocoon of the
silk-worm; a pill; a pearl; [cf. गुडिका, गुलिका,
गुली, गुड.]
—गुटिकाञ्जन (˚का-अञ्˚), अम्, n.
collyrium formed like a globe or ball.
—गुटिका-
मुख, अस्, ई, अम्, furnished with a rounded orifice.
